title: Large Language Models Show Amplified Cognitive Biases in Moral Decision-Making
overview: Cheung, Maier & Lieder (2025): LLMs versus people in moral dilemmas. Runnable replay: Study 1 moral dilemmas (13, sequential) and Study 2 (six dilemmas x three framings). Studies 3, 4 and the collective action problems are described in the program but not runnable.

readiness.note: No blocking issues. Study 3, Study 1 collective action problems and Study 4 are outside the replay scope; see audit.
